Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

should — used to give advice. Example: You should leave earlier.
advice — an opinion about what you should do. Example: My advice is to leave earlier.
try — to attempt something. Example: You should try it.
solution — a way to fix a problem. Example: A good solution is to change the time.
change — to make something different. Example: You should change your alarm time.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• You should ...
• You should try ...
• A good solution is ...
• My advice is ...
• Try it!
